response.overview: Shymyr arrives in the city in search of a tractor part and stays with his old army buddy, Yeldos. But he soon finds himself caught up in a dangerous confrontation with a powerful criminal syndicate. Drawn into the heart of the conflict, Shymyr decides to take matters into his own hands, standing up to those accustomed to imposing their will through force, money, and connections. A man of few words, he relies on his combat skills to take on an enemy who clearly underestimates him.
